entries.zh: 使用（花费、耗用钱财）
entries.en: to use; to spend (money)

entries.zh: 费用（花费、开支）
entries.en: expense(s); cost

entries.zh: （俗语说法）花钱、开销（原文作“使費瀉/濶用”，第二字存疑）
entries.en: to spend (in vulgar/colloquial speech); to lay out money
entries.notes: 汉字第二字“[疑:瀉/濶]”未能定夺，据 M 栏 hôg 音写与西语 gastar vulgar（俗语“花钱”）推断释义

entries.zh: 乱使用（胡乱花费、滥花）
entries.en: to spend without order, use wastefully

entries.zh: 虚费（空耗、虚耗钱财；首字原文疑“屋/虛”）
entries.en: to spend wastefully, dissipate in vain
entries.notes: 首字“[疑:屋/虛]”未定夺；依 M 栏 hiù 音写推定作“虛費”（虚耗）

entries.zh: 耗费（耗损、浪费）
entries.en: to squander, waste

entries.zh: 打损（耗费损伤、使亏折）
entries.en: to damage, ruin (by spending); to wear down

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语栏缩写/污损未能展开；汉字“煙(囡?)人”与音写 ién-lâng 语义未能定夺，西语侧似指挥霍者（gastador）
entries.en: 〔damaged source, gloss uncertain〕 Spanish column garbled/abbreviated ("ganam⁵te", "azy~") and unexpanded; Chinese 煙/囡人 (ién-lâng) undetermined, Spanish side suggests "gastador" (spendthrift)
entries.notes: 西语栏 ganam⁵te、azy~ 疑为缩写或污损、无法展开，汉字又有[疑]，语义无法定夺故降 low

entries.zh: 甘食（疑“憨食”；舍得吃用、不吝饮食；西语谓花用而不吝啬）
entries.en: to spend/eat freely, without miserliness (first char 甘/憨 uncertain)
entries.notes: 首字“[疑:甘/憨]”未定夺；据西语 sin miseria（不吝啬）取“舍得吃用”义

entries.zh: 够用（用度足以敷需；首字原文疑“到/夠”）
entries.en: enough to spend/use; to spend only what is necessary
entries.notes: 首字“[疑:到/夠]”未定夺；二者音近（M 栏 caù）义通，取“足用”义

entries.zh: 够使（足敷使费、够用；首字原文疑“到/夠”）
entries.en: enough to use/spend (sufficient)
entries.notes: 首字“[疑:到/夠]”未定夺；依 M 栏 caù 音写取“足用”义

entries.zh: 尽财使（把钱财用尽、倾财而花）
entries.en: to spend all one's money

entries.zh: 徒费钱（白白花钱、无益之费；首字原文疑“徒/杜”）
entries.en: to spend money in vain, wastefully (sin provecho "without benefit")
entries.notes: 首字“[疑:徒/杜]”未定夺；于义取“徒”（空、白）

entries.zh: 简略（简省从略、从简办理；第二字原文疑“畧/署”）
entries.en: brief, simplified; to cut short, economize
entries.notes: 第二字“[疑:畧/署]”未定夺；M 栏 quiag（kiak）音近“畧”

entries.zh: 简省（节省、从简）
entries.en: to economize, be frugal; to simplify

entries.zh: 奢侈（奢华讲究、衣着挥霍）
entries.en: extravagant, luxurious (to spend much on one's dress)
entries.notes: 第二音节调号 T99（污損难辨）属录证缺损，按规程降 low；字面“奢侈”与西语语义本身清晰

entries.zh: 奢华（奢华铺张、讲究穿戴）
entries.en: luxurious, sumptuous

entries.zh: 破财（破耗钱财、钱财折损）
entries.en: to squander money; loss of wealth (quiebra dinero)

entries.zh: 侵使（侵用、挪费钱物而挥霍；首字原文疑“侵/浸”）
entries.en: to spend by encroaching upon (funds); Spanish side: "big spender" (gastador grande)
entries.notes: 首字“[疑:侵/浸]”未定夺；依西语 gastador grande 与 M 栏 chím 音写取“侵用”义

entries.zh: 破费（破耗花费、破财用度）
entries.en: to spend, lay out money; to treat (at one's expense)

entries.zh: 丰费（挥霍多费、铺张花费；首字原文疑“豐/風”）
entries.en: lavish, immoderate spending; Spanish side: spendthrift/idle spender (holgazán)
entries.notes: 首字“[疑:豐/風]”未定夺；依西语 holgacan（holgazán，挥霍游惰者）取“铺张挥霍”义

entries.zh: 消蚀（家财日渐耗蚀、坐吃渐消）
entries.en: to waste away, dwindle (of one's estate/hacienda)
